title: Chapter 72: True Or False
content:
Chapter 72: True Or False

The Tengu clan's contempt for the Alliance is a good thing for both the Alliance and the Zerg, as it can buy more time for the Alliance and the Zerg to develop.

But all this is just Wu Qing's guess, and the real situation is unknown.

Just as the Tengu clan does not understand the development potential of the Zerg yet, Wu Qing also knows very little about the situation of the Tengu clan.

[I hope readers will remember our domain name Taiwan Novel Network → ᴛᴡᴋᴀɴ.ᴄᴏᴍ]

In this situation, many things must be prepared for the worst.

Meng threw away the order letter in his hand and wanted to walk towards the Tengu clan guide. Wu Qing pulled him and signaled Yu Chong to go over to communicate.

Meng's style of doing things sometimes scares people. This guide is very important. It would be more appropriate for Yu Chong, a handsome man who is easy to make people feel good, to communicate.

The three of them simply exchanged a few words in a low voice, and Yu Chong walked towards the Tengu clan guide.

"Greetings, Lord!"

Facing the Lord, the Tengu guide dismounted his lizard mount and expressed his respect.

Wu Qing had little knowledge of the age of these beast-headed races, and could only roughly judge from their voices that this Tengu guide should be a relatively young Tengu.

"No need to be polite!"

"Next, our army will rely on you to lead, can you tell us about the situation first?"

Yu Chong also dismounted from the tall white unicorn, smiling and speaking in a gentle tone.

A lord who can speak to others in this manner is indeed easy to gain the favor and trust of others.

"Lord! Our mission today is to cut off a main supply line of the evil god camp's garrison camp!"

"This supply line is very important. We send people to harass it every day, and the enemy's defense is also very tight!"

"Yesterday, a big battle took place on this line, and our elite troops who went to carry out the interception mission were almost wiped out!"

"So, we have a lot of difficulties in completing today's mission!"

When the Tengu guide reported the situation to Yu Chong, Wu Qing, Meng, and Bai Yan also got off their mounts, walked over, and listened on the side.

"Is there a map?"

"Yes!"

The Tengu guide took out a simple map and opened it, and Yu Chong, Wu Qing and the other three surrounded it.

"To the west is our camp, and to the east is the camp of the evil god camp."

"There are many small territories around the camps of both sides, and these territories have garrisoned troops."

"The supply route we need to cut off this time is in the east of the enemy camp. If we want to get there, we need to go around a big circle."

"This requires close cooperation from the scouts."

The Tengu guide stopped here.

"What's wrong? Is there trouble here for the scouts?"

Yu Chong asked softly.

"Yes, Lord, there is no scout to pick us up this time, so we need to rely on our own strength to get around."

The Tengu guide was a little depressed.

"That's no problem, go on."

Yu Chong comforted.

"Based on past experience, the enemy will organize defense lines here, here, and here to prevent us from destroying them."

"Sometimes they will ambush in these areas, or send small troops to roam around to block our march and retreat."

"..."

The Tengu guide pointed at the map, compared it with the map, and explained in detail all the information he knew.

I just don't know where his information came from, and whether the content he said is true and reliable.

The Tengu tribe wants the alliance army to go to war. Even if they want the alliance army to die, it is best to cause certain losses to the enemy. Some of this information must be true.

But some of the important information about the life and death of the army should have been concealed. The unstable factors such as the alliance army are best used as high-level cannon fodder.

Back to the mission itself, according to the intelligence analysis provided by the Tengu guide, this mission is very difficult for ordinary troops to complete, and it is somewhat difficult for elite troops, but as long as the command is proper, it is possible to complete the mission.

On the surface, this is not a mission that is certain to die. The surface work of the Tengu tribe is done very well.

"Do you have any good suggestions?"

Yu Chong looked at the Tengu guide and asked.

The Tengu guide did not dare to look at Yu Chong. After thinking for a while, he whispered: "I don't have any good suggestions, but you must be careful!"

"Okay, thank you for your reminder!"

"Let us borrow the map. You go to rest first. We will set off when we are ready!"

Yu Chong took the map from the Tengu guide and asked a logistics staff to take the guide to rest.

The four lords invited Niu Kun to come over, and everyone studied this map that they did not know whether it was true or false.

"Lord Niu Kun, do you have a map of this area?"

The first thing everyone thought of was Niu Kun, to see if he had some information in his hand.

"No, I am not familiar with this area, and I don't have the map."

Niu Kun was not much better than everyone else. He was almost in the dark. They just followed the large army to fight, and they didn't have to think about so many things.

Although the Ox Tribe is unpopular, they are one of the main forces on the battlefield. Generally speaking, no one would deliberately harm them.

"There is no way to verify the authenticity of intelligence and maps now, so it depends on our own reconnaissance capabilities!"

"Without reliable intelligence, discussing combat plans now may cause big problems!"

"If possible, I want the Zerg to complete this mission alone, and I will accompany you to rest here, how about it?"

Wu Qing felt that it would be more convenient for the Zerg to go alone for such a combat mission. With other troops, some tactics would be difficult to perform.

But he knew the temper of Meng and the others. If they were not allowed to play in the battle, they would definitely not be able to bear it.

Sure enough, Meng, Yu Chong, and Bai Yan all disagreed.

"You can't stay here with us!"

"Since we are an alliance, we should fight this war together!"

"Our troops will never retreat! We are not afraid of death!"

"The Zerg have the awareness that they will not go back after coming here! We have it too!"

"Wu Qing, you can fight the Zerg way without worrying about us!"

Meng knew that Wu Qing meant well, but he knew that if he didn't advance, he would retreat. If he got used to the protection of the Zerg, it would not be a good thing for the alliance.

They are not lacking in the spirit of facing death!

Although bringing other troops may increase the burden and losses of the Zerg, this spirit of the alliance is worthy of admiration. Wu Qing can only accompany everyone to fight a few times in public.

"Okay! Then leave the logistics troops here and let Lord Niu Kun take care of them!"

Wu Qing agreed to join the alliance army and only leave the logistics team here.

"No problem, leave your logistics troops to me! I guarantee that they are intact!"

Niu Kun patted his chest and promised.

"Then everyone, go and prepare. The specific battle plan, we will discuss it on the way after we get the real intelligence!"

Wu Qing was ready to act according to the intelligence detected by the Zerg, just fight a battle, so as not to fall into the pit.

As for the mission objectives and the guide intelligence, if they really fight according to the arrangement of the Tengu clan, they will not know how they will die in the end.

Meng and the others also knew this truth, so he threw the battle order directly into the mud pit.
